# Missing Repository Registration Handling

The inspect command may raise a ClickException if a repository is not registered before querying. This could lead to unexpected application behavior if the user forgets to register a repository.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.inspect_cmd`
